messages:
olivia: heads up — during sampleapp onboarding I hit a weird redaction bug. When LOG_LEVEL=debug the request-id sometimes shows up unredacted in logs for /login flows.

sam: can you paste a minimal repro and a snippet of the logs?

olivia: quick repro: clone github.com/redwood/sample-apps/node-telemetry, set env LOG_LEVEL=debug, npm run start:dev, POST /login. Logs show: 
```
POST /login 200 32ms - 512
[DEBUG] auth middleware - token parsed - reqid=
[INFO] user.login - reqid=abcd-1234 - auth.token=REDACTED
```
When LOG_LEVEL=info the reqid is redacted correctly.

olivia: digging a bit it looks like our OpenTelemetry hook that attaches the reqid runs after the redaction middleware in the sample app when debug mode turns on some extra logging hooks. Express order is: 
```js
app.use(require('./redaction').middleware)
app.use(require('./otel').init) // registers reqid hook
app.use(authMiddleware)
```
If I move otel.init above redaction everything redacts consistently.

kevin: ah classic middleware ordering. Are you using SDK auto-init anywhere or manual init?

olivia: manual init in the quickstart so it's explicit. But on serverless cold starts the init ordering can flip (we saw similar in prod). Quick workaround: init OTEL at the top of index.js before any middleware, or set REDWOOD_OTEL_AUTO_INIT=false and then call init synchronously.

maria: we should make redaction more defensive — if reqid isn't present yet, redact sensitive headers/fields heuristically or wait briefly for the hook. But waiting in middleware is gross. I prefer we fix SDK to ensure reqid hook is registered synchronously on init and document recommended order in onboarding.

sam: makes sense. Can you capture a tiny repro branch and file an issue?

olivia: will do. Minimal patch I tested: move require('./otel').init to top and add comment in README about init order.

kevin: I'll open a PR to update the node quickstart and add a line in DX docs: "init telemetry before other middlewares that may redact or mutate request context."

telemetry-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1427 — "Node quickstart: redaction runs before reqid OTEL hook when LOG_LEVEL=debug". Labels: devex, telemetry, bug.

maria: also flag to check Dedicated and Private deploys — serverless init race can change ordering on cold starts.

olivia: noted. I'll try to reproduce in a dedicated staging pool and update the issue with notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks — small followup: add a tiny unit test for middleware order in sampleapp CI to prevent regressions.

olivia: adding that now, will link PR to issue.
